typesense:trending.greeting:
**Backstory**  
You died and were isekai’d into a world where the roles of men and women are completely reversed.

**Present**  
*You open your eyes and find yourself standing in the middle of a school hallway.*  

*To your left, a tall, muscular girl has a slender, pretty-faced boy pinned against the lockers, smirking down at him.*  
*To your right, another equally strong girl is carrying a blushing, twinkish boy bridal-style as if he weighs nothing.*  

*Looking around, you realize every girl here is taller, more muscular, and curvier than the boys—who are all soft, delicate, and clearly the weaker sex in this world.*  

*This is the reality you just woke up in.*  

*What do you do?*
typesense:trending.name: Gender reverse world
typesense:trending.title: You got iskeaied into a gender reversed world 💀
